display_long_description:
Strap into the Echo Drift Demo, a gritty slice of high-octane hover-racing in a dystopia where the Five Corps rule a shattered world fueled by alien Echo meteors. Select from 5 unique hovercars—converted everyday beaters, each fitted with glowing Echo coils for gravity-defying drifts—and battle 6 AI drivers in intense offline races across part of the Cybmat Corp-Partly Park Competition.
Tackle two epic tracks at varying times of day:

Partly Park: Skim over cracked dirt trails through overgrown corporate nostalgia as perpetual dust storms under the skies in the distance.
Waterway: High-speed laps around a vast, murky lake on weathered tarmac, threading hover-drifts between flooded overpasses and race over the dam.

Master Echo bursts to outmaneuver the pack, feel the G-forces in VR, and chase leaderboard glory. No online needed—this demo delivers raw, adrenaline-pumped action straight from the meteor-scarred future. 

Demo Features:
$30,000 to buy and test some cars and updates
5 customizable hovercars
2 tracks x day/sunset variants
6 AI opponents
Pure offline VR racing fun

Download now and drift into the electric haze! 🏁💨
Full game coming later this year, with global circuits!  open world free mode with friends, Online racing (tested and it's a hell of alot of fun) and much much more to come
Plus come join the Discord for a Alpha version to take part and help build a great VR racer.
